_comment: Five OoE glyphs for Shanoa (user, 2026-11-24). Weapons go in her two weapon slots like Dextro/Sinestro Custos (WEPN rows from Dextro Custos, category 10 shot modules); spells go in her glyph slots like Luminatio (GLYP rows from Luminatio, category 3 shot modules). Every module is the 8-bit DLC's R. Zombie soul code rebased; behaviour is src/shanoa_glyph_*_module.cpp. Art: the player's own OoE ROM, converted 1:1 (tools/ooe_glyph_art.py). Package 20 = the Shanoa glyph pack with Refectio and Arma Custos (user, 2026-11-24). Weapon ATK is [mastery 1, max]: like Confodere and the Custos pair it scales with her glyph-mastery collection (8245D178, def mode 2) and STR (824519C8, which 82533878 uses for category 10 shots). Scutum deals no damage (user): ATK 0 and its OoE hitboxes stripped. Numbers are first-pass picks, to tune. tools/shanoa_glyphs.py reads this file.

en:
Draws a bow and looses an arrow
straight ahead.
de:
Spannt einen Bogen und schießt
einen Pfeil geradeaus.
es:
Tensa un arco y dispara una
flecha hacia delante.
fr:
Bande un arc et décoche une
flèche droit devant.
it:
Tende un arco e scocca una
freccia in avanti.
ja:
ゆみを ひき まえに
やを はなつ

glyphs._extras: test 6: an impact spark on terrain, as HoD's Axe subweapon shows; OoE raw16 animation 0 (a white-orange star burst)

en:
Tosses a spinning axe
in an arc.
de:
Wirft eine wirbelnde Axt
im Bogen.
es:
Lanza un hacha giratoria
en arco.
fr:
Lance une hache tournoyante
en arc de cercle.
ja:
かいてんする おのを
ほうぶつせんに なげる

glyphs._shift: test 3: the shield never drew; its art sat 37-61 px above the sprite origin (OoE draws it relative to Shanoa), so the frames are moved down onto the origin and the shot is placed overhead instead

de:
Hebt einen Schild über
den Kopf.
es:
Alza un escudo sobre
la cabeza.
fr:
Lève un bouclier au-dessus
de la tête.
it:
Alza uno scudo sopra
la testa.
ja:
たてを ずじょうに
かかげる

glyphs._boxes: OoE gives ram08 no hitboxes (its hit was code); attack boxes added: soul head (flight frames 0-3) and burst (6-10)

en:
Releases a soul of darkness
that seeks out enemies.
de:
Entlässt eine Seele der
Dunkelheit, die Feinde jagt.
es:
Libera un alma de oscuridad
que persigue enemigos.
fr:
Libère une âme de ténèbres
qui traque les ennemis.
it:
Libera un'anima d'oscurità
che insegue i nemici.
ja:
てきを おいかける
やみの たましいを はなつ

en:
Drops a block that can be
stood on. It soon crumbles.
de:
Lässt einen begehbaren Block
fallen, der bald zerfällt.
es:
Deja caer un bloque sobre el
que subir. Pronto se deshace.
fr:
Fait tomber un bloc praticable
qui s'effrite vite.
it:
Fa cadere un blocco su cui
salire. Presto si sgretola.
ja:
のれる ブロックを おとす
すぐに くずれる
